description: Source code for Leaflet.markercluster plugin, defining the MarkerClusterGroup class which extends L.FeatureGroup to provide marker clustering functionality in Leaflet maps.

classes.name: MarkerClusterGroup
classes.description: A class extending L.FeatureGroup that manages clustering of markers with options for animation, chunked loading, and various clustering behaviors.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the MarkerClusterGroup with provided options, setting up internal groups and event handlers.

methods.name: addLayer
methods.description: Adds a layer (marker or group) to the cluster group, handling clustering logic and visibility.

methods.name: removeLayer
methods.description: Removes a layer from the cluster group, updating clusters and bounds accordingly.

methods.name: addLayers
methods.description: Adds multiple layers in bulk, with chunked processing for performance.

methods.name: removeLayers
methods.description: Removes multiple layers in bulk, updating clusters and bounds.

methods.name: clearLayers
methods.description: Removes all layers from the cluster group.

methods.name: getBounds
methods.description: Returns the bounds of all clustered markers.

methods.name: eachLayer
methods.description: Iterates over all layers managed by the cluster group.

methods.name: getLayers
methods.description: Returns an array of all layers.

methods.name: getLayer
methods.description: Retrieves a layer by its ID.

methods.name: hasLayer
methods.description: Checks if a layer is in the cluster group.

methods.name: zoomToShowLayer
methods.description: Zooms the map to show a specific layer, spiderfying if necessary.

methods.name: onAdd
methods.description: Handles adding the cluster group to a map, initializing clusters and event handlers.

methods.name: onRemove
methods.description: Handles removing the cluster group from a map, cleaning up event handlers and layers.

methods.name: getVisibleParent
methods.description: Returns the visible parent marker of a given marker.

methods.name: _arraySplice
methods.description: Removes an object from an array if present.

methods.name: _removeFromGridUnclustered
methods.description: Removes a marker from all unclustered grids starting at a specified zoom level.

methods.name: _childMarkerDragStart
methods.description: Handles the start of a child marker drag event.

methods.name: _childMarkerMoved
methods.description: Handles movement of a child marker during drag.

methods.name: _moveChild
methods.description: Moves a marker from one position to another within the cluster group.

methods.name: _childMarkerDragEnd
methods.description: Handles the end of a child marker drag event.

methods.name: _removeLayer
methods.description: Removes a marker from clusters and updates parent clusters and grids.

methods.name: _isOrIsParent
methods.description: Checks if an element is or is a parent of another element.

methods.name: fire
methods.description: Overrides event firing to handle cluster-specific events.

methods.name: listens
methods.description: Overrides event listening to include cluster events.

methods.name: _defaultIconCreateFunction
methods.description: Creates default cluster icons based on child count.

methods.name: _bindEvents
methods.description: Binds cluster-specific events like click and hover.

methods.name: _zoomOrSpiderfy
methods.description: Handles cluster click to either spiderfy or zoom.

methods.name: _showCoverage
methods.description: Displays coverage polygon on hover.

methods.name: _hideCoverage
methods.description: Hides coverage polygon.

methods.name: _unbindEvents
methods.description: Unbinds cluster events.

methods.name: _zoomEnd
methods.description: Handles actions after zoom ends, updating clusters.

methods.name: _moveEnd
methods.description: Handles actions after map move ends, updating cluster visibility.

methods.name: _generateInitialClusters
methods.description: Initializes clustering grids and top cluster level.

methods.name: _addLayer
methods.description: Adds a single layer to the clustering structure at the appropriate zoom level.

methods.name: _refreshClustersIcons
methods.description: Updates icons for dirty clusters.

methods.name: _enqueue
methods.description: Queues functions to run after clustering animations.

methods.name: _processQueue
methods.description: Processes queued functions.

methods.name: _mergeSplitClusters
methods.description: Merges or splits clusters based on zoom level and bounds.

methods.name: _getExpandedVisibleBounds
methods.description: Returns bounds expanded to include off-screen areas for better clustering.

methods.name: _checkBoundsMaxLat
methods.description: Expands bounds to max latitude limits if necessary.

methods.name: _animationAddLayerNonAnimated
methods.description: Adds a layer without animation, updating clusters accordingly.

methods.name: _extractNonGroupLayers
methods.description: Recursively extracts non-group layers from a layer group.

methods.name: _overrideMarkerIcon
methods.description: Overrides marker icon for single marker mode.

methods.name: markerClusterGroup
methods.description: Factory function to create a new MarkerClusterGroup instance.
